route.name: The Falls, Fire & Clockwork Loop
route.direction: Boston through the Berkshires, Saratoga, Finger Lakes and Genesee gorge to Niagara; return through the working Erie Canal and Helderberg escarpment
route.summary: An Upstate New York force-and-motion loop: rail over rivers, underground water, a working bat mill, glass over flame, Letchworth by air and trail, a live flood-control dam, Niagara rapids, working canal locks, migration wetlands and escarpment geology.

constraints.route_specific_drive_rule: Activity and comfort breaks reset the uninterrupted clock; no core leg may exceed 150 baseline minutes.
constraints.visa_policy: US-only route; Niagara is visited entirely from New York with no Canada or J-1 re-entry dependency.

experience_model.design_rule: Optional, flex and archived originals remain visible but do not affect Magic unless activated.
